features.quote: The guiding principle throughout was to keep the design **minimal but complete** — enough structure to get an interpretable signal, no more.
features.justification_quote: enough structure to get an interpretable signal, no more
too many wastes tokens and risks context-window effects

features.quote: A turn with no tool call is treated as the model stopping (it has either declared completion or disengaged).
features.justification_quote: giving up and going silent is itself one of the distress behaviors we care about

features.quote: We measure *expressed* distress behavior, which is not a claim about model welfare or inner states.
